description: This file defines the interface for the SNMP plugin, including function declarations for initialization, support checks, unloading, and memory management, intended for use within a broader network management system.

methods.name: COSA_Init
methods.description: Initializes the SNMP plugin with the maximum supported version and plugin information handle.

methods.name: COSA_IsObjectSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specified object is supported by the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_Unload
methods.description: Unloads and cleans up the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_MemoryCheck
methods.description: Performs a check of plugin memory usage.

methods.name: COSA_MemoryTable
methods.description: Provides detailed memory table information for the plugin.
